items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But Pam’s Waltz and Little Niles, he goes – every time he record, we’ll do those things.

ctx.x: But he – but Randy uses his song Little Niles in all these different versions kind of like Dizzy used Manteca and like you did. He changes it up, but it’s still the same song, in different clothing. And that’s great.
But Pam’s Waltz and Little Niles, he goes – every time he record, we’ll do those things. So anyway . . .
Yeah. All right, then. That’s what a lot of people do. That keeps the money rolling in too.
